name: PackageSliderCard
job: A single slider with named stops that morphs one package card (name, price, included items) as the visitor drags between tiers
visitor_action: drag the thumb or press arrow keys; tap a stop label
owner_settings: Packages (name, price, short tagline, included items one per line)
mobile: slider above card, thumb snaps to stops
motion: thumb snaps with spring, price counts to the new value, included items check in one by one (reduced-motion: instant card swap)

checks.render: pass (1 fix: worst-case stop labels showed a clipped third line)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Tailor's counter: pale oat card, deep claret thumb and track ticks, tape-measure numerals, fine pinstripe edge
notes: Drag, spring snap and check-in stagger are not visible in stills and were not interaction-tested in a live browser; long stop names clamp to 2 lines under the tape (full name shows on the card).
